summary: Completed comprehensive testing of HRMS Phase 2 features. Backend APIs 100% functional, frontend UI working well with Indian compliance features. All authentication, dashboard, leave management, tax calculator, notification system, and onboarding features tested successfully.

design_issues.issue: Session timeout causing redirects to login page during extended testing sessions

passed_tests: Dashboard stats endpoint with all required fields
Tax calculation returns correct fields: earnings, deductions, net_salary, ctc
Admin dashboard shows 6 stat cards with notification bell in header
Sidebar has all 12 modules: Dashboard, Employees, Departments, Hierarchy, Attendance, Leave, Payroll, Reimbursements, Documents, Recruitment, Performance, Onboarding
Payroll page has Salary Calculator button that opens Indian tax calculator dialog
Leave page shows leave balance cards for employee login (6 Indian leave types)
Indian tax compliance calculation working (PF, ESIC, TDS, PT)
Cross-login prevention (admin can't login as employee and vice versa)
Leave balance cards showing correct Indian leave types and balances
Salary calculator dialog with proper Indian tax fields and calculations
